name: observe
description: An /observe pane with a tab per provider: Docker containers, Modal containers and their cost, and Render and Vercel deploys with the current git branch highlighted. `/observe docker|modal|render|vercel` opens it on that tab

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Which tabs the pane has, in this order: docker, modal, render, vercel. Empty shows all four.

docker_context.title: Docker context
docker_context.description: The docker context to list (docker --context). Empty follows DOCKER_HOST, then your current context (docker context use).

docker_all.title: Docker: include stopped containers
docker_all.description: Also list exited and created containers (docker ps --all).

docker_refresh_seconds.title: Docker: refresh interval (seconds)
docker_refresh_seconds.description: How often the Docker tab refreshes while it is on screen.

modal_environment.title: Modal environment
modal_environment.description: The Modal environment to list, e.g. main or dev. Empty follows MODAL_ENVIRONMENT, then your modal profile's environment (modal config set-environment), then the workspace default.

render_services.title: Render services
render_services.description: Comma-separated Render service names to show. Empty shows every service, up to the service cap.

render_max_services.title: Render: service cap
render_max_services.description: Most services to list deploys for. A full refresh makes one request per service.

vercel_team.title: Vercel team
vercel_team.description: Vercel team id (team_...) or slug. Empty uses the team in .vercel/project.json, else your personal account.

vercel_project.title: Vercel project
vercel_project.description: Vercel project id or name to show. Empty uses the project linked in .vercel/project.json, else every project.

deploy_max_rows.title: Deploys: rows
deploy_max_rows.description: How many deploys the Render and Vercel tabs list, newest first.

deploy_refresh_seconds.title: Deploys: refresh interval (seconds)
deploy_refresh_seconds.description: How often the Render and Vercel tabs refresh while on screen. On Render, also the longest gap between full refreshes while something builds.

deploy_building_refresh_seconds.title: Deploys: refresh interval while building (seconds)
deploy_building_refresh_seconds.description: How often the Render and Vercel tabs re-check while a deploy is building.

notify_on_finish.title: Toast when a branch deploy finishes
notify_on_finish.description: While their tab is not on screen, keep watching deploys of the current git branch that were building and show a toast when each one is ready or fails.
